facts.fact: The Homeland Security Minister said verification will now rely on real-time biometrics against the National Registration Bureau database.
The Nzika Digital ID, launched in Lilongwe, lets citizens present verified credentials through the Nzika Wallet, and the NRB Principal Secretary said over 22,000 Malawians have already obtained it.
The Nzika Wallet lets citizens present verified credentials digitally and can be used to access services before receiving a physical card, per the Homeland Security Minister.

MWI.note: The document counts children in civil registration but states no exchange between the civil register and the ID system.

facts.fact: The ICT Minister said the national ID system has over 13.5 million people registered, about 99 percent of citizens aged 16 and above; against the population of 22.2 million held (2025) that is about 61 percent of all ages.

MWI.note: The document does not mention an ID number given at birth.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the ID system.
The document does not mention registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The ICT Minister said the national ID system has over 13.5 million people registered, and National ID cards no longer expire.
